What should sales representative work experience first?

Start with needs and product matching, then check packaging, the quote formula, and unconfirmed terms. Experience the process of continuous follow-up and stating unknowns, then investigate real customer development and pay conditions.
Paper checking is for career exploration and cannot prove closing ability, credit judgment, or signing authority.

Willingness to listen carefully to needs, check the catalog, and follow up repeatedly, and being able to separate what the customer actually said from your own suggestions. This shows preparation habits and still needs real training and feedback.

If you only like showing products and do not want to check packaging, amounts, and delivery dates, improve your document habits first. Sales targets cannot become a reason to invent customer confirmation, promise inventory, or skip approvals.

Check Q1—Q3 independently and record product mismatches, formula differences, and unknown delivery dates; after the experience, check one real sales job's products, customers, travel, and income components.

Sells wholesalers' and manufacturers' goods to businesses or groups and requires thorough product knowledge; this occupation excludes technical and scientific products, which does not mean product knowledge is unnecessary.
Answer questions about products, prices, availability, uses, and credit terms and recommend per customer needs; check unknown inventory or terms first and do not replace facts with fluent talk.

Estimate or provide prices, contract credit terms, warranties, and delivery dates; preparing contract orders is a task, and specific discount, credit, and signing authority is still confirmed by the unit.

Introduce products to existing and potential customers and seek orders, using catalogs, samples, and trade show information; customer information collection must follow actual data and business rules.

Follow up on problems after signing or sales and coordinate with the manufacturer, delivery, and internal staff. Follow-up does not mean the representative can promise all delivery or installation matters.
Keep sales records, budgets, and reports, understand market and product changes, and check inventory; a digital CRM or ERP is not the same as having adopted generative AI.

The typical BLS entry for this occupation is high school equivalent, no related work experience required, and medium-term on-the-job training; the two Chinese campus jobs require a bachelor degree, which is a specific employer condition.

What is the difference between needs communication and quote checking?

The former understands the use and product fit, and the latter checks SKU, unit, amount, and terms. A smooth meeting cannot prove the quote is correct, and an identical amount cannot offset a product mismatch.

values: Material｜Fictional Q1—Q3 office supply quote

Catalog: A4-P has 10 packs per case at 8 yuan/pack; PEN is 12 yuan/box; NOTE is 12 yuan/box. The prices are entirely fictional, only the product and amount are checked, taxes and freight are excluded, and they are not a real commercial quote.

Needs and original draft: Q1 wants A4-P three cases, draft A4-P30 packs × 8 = 240 yuan, delivery date D5 (confirmed in the problem); Q2 wants PEN five boxes, draft NOTE five boxes × 12 = 60 yuan, delivery date D5 (confirmed in the problem); Q3 wants A4-P two cases, draft A4-P20 packs × 8 = 150 yuan, delivery date blank. D5 is only a fictional marker and does not mean real days.
Your task
Compare the need SKU with the draft row by row, convert cases and packs per the catalog, and recalculate; list product mismatches, amount differences, and unknown delivery dates separately.

Keep the original draft and write the result and reason in the revision column; an unconfirmed delivery date cannot be filled with D5, an equal amount does not mean the same product, and no discount is assumed.
Reference approach

Q1 product, quantity, and amount are consistent: 3×10=30 packs, 30×8=240. The Q2 amount 60 formula holds, but the required PEN differs from the draft NOTE; after checking the original need, list the product revision as to be confirmed.

Q3 two cases = 20 packs, 20×8=160, and the original 150 is 10 short; the problem gives no discount basis. Three items: Q2 product mismatch, Q3 amount differs by 10, Q3 delivery date missing. Q3 cannot write D5 by relying on other rows, and must not invent stock or customer consent.
Exercise boundaries
Only fictional paper material is checked; do not contact customers, check real inventory, or send formal quotes or contracts.

title.text: Sales Representatives, Wholesale and Manufacturing, Except Technical and Scientific Products

subject.name: Sales Representatives, Wholesale and Manufacturing, Except Technical and Scientific Products
subject.summary: Wholesale and manufacturing sales representatives, except technical and scientific products, sell wholesalers' and manufacturers' goods to businesses or groups within U.S. 41-4012.00 and need thorough knowledge of the goods sold. Daily work includes understanding needs, recommending products, quote and term communication, preparing orders and contracts, following up after sales, and sales records. Technical and scientific product sales 41-4011, sales engineers 41-9031, and consumer retail are separated separately; Chinese jobs are compared by product and actual duties.
